oracle.name: Model-driven app UCI (hosted environment)
oracle.scope: Two native UCI runs on 2026-11-09 of 15 ordered addOption and removeOption calls on one standard single-select choice control (setup: clearOptions, addOption One=1 and Two=2; the native blank option is retained). Establishes the control option list before and after each call and the returned value or the error name and message. Does not establish attribute metadata options (One and Two are control setup, not attribute metadata), the Paqvilo internal state map, or form save and dirty state.

error.name: UciError
error.message: Value should be of type: number: Parameter Name: optionSetItem.value
